rule:
Reading rules (previous order 7.1 and 7.5; this order 9.1, 9.6, 9.7): criterion = max of the pooled spread (only the four named
metrics), the method's unit spread 2.8 |s0 - s1| / sqrt 2 and three points 300 / n for shares. CDGS is a single-seed comparator
without a fixed seed: '확인' only beyond twice the criterion, between once and twice '가능, 근거 불완전'. Fewer than 100 samples:
'표본 부족'. Past-shape inflow, observation-error inflow within the threshold and detail accuracy below 10,000 samples: at most
'가능, 근거 불완전'. CDGS detail accuracy is reference only (not read); B0 detail accuracy is not read; B173만 is report-only.
'변형(크기 맞추기 생략), 고정 씨앗 없음' is written beside every comparison-4 answer line. Names of this order 4.8: the third 8.2 class
is written '나누지 못함' (the previous tables' label differs in name only). The CDGS cell of '벽 있음' is this order's item-6 count on
the CDGS virtual-view mesh (SL/tables/virtual_main.json rows/wall_virtual), the same count as the previous order's
figs/wall_presence.json 'share' of the Gaussian methods.
